ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: both models score similarly on Creative Generation (82.7 Plover vs 81.2 Lapwing — within stated variance), so capability isn't the deciding factor. I routed to Lapwing because the task is a warm, humorous, open-ended creative request, which sits squarely in Lapwing's strongest self-reported preference zone (high novelty/latitude, friendly tone). Plover self-reports an aversion to exactly this kind of open-ended generative work. Since output quality is comparable, matching the task to the model that "prefers" it was the tiebreaker.
